contest.note: Totals 4.83 / 4.599 / 2.92 ms are measured. Stage shares are model estimates until nsys / ncu replace them.

playbook.source: CUDA kernel estimate loop — independent loads, round trips, busiest resource, occupancy, floor gap.
formulas: time_term = work / rate  (the max term is the bound)

ref.ldESplits: LD.E generic load splits a 32 B access into 2 × 16 B
ref.stgPartialWaste: Partial STG fills still pay 32 B; short store bursts behind compute are almost free
ref.occupancy: Read resident blocks from the occupancy API (get_blocks_per_sm / CUDA occupancy). Do not divide total blocks by SM count.

reduction.name: cluster + DSMEM
reduction.note: SM-to-SM shared memory inside one GPC. Size cap. Must land on one GPC.

reduction.name: global atomics
reduction.note: Last CTA to the counter. Floating-point atomics → result order is not stable.

reduction.name: launch another kernel
reduction.note: Kernel A writes partials, kernel B reduces. Extra launch, simplest correctness.

bf16.name: bf16_proj
bf16.solving: Five skinny GEMMs. Input x is tiny [m, 8192]; the weights are 188 MiB.
bf16.notSolving: Tensor Core peak. At m=16 the real math is ≈ 3 µs.

trips.label: Weight stream · two HBM trips if address and payload are serial
after: wait on m / deps + compute overlap

slices.name: GEMM math
slices.why: Physics floor. The 1.33 ms compute bar on the pipeline is mostly load stalls, not multiply-adds. Do not tune tiles at small m.
slices.methodNote: Stop. No space on the math itself.

slices.name: Stream weights
slices.why: 188 MiB at HBM peak ≈ 59 µs. Prefetch cannot hide 59 µs behind 3 µs of math. Cutting bytes (single-FP8) is the only way to move the physics floor.
slices.methodNote: Single-FP8 weight reads, gated on error. Prefetch with LDG.128. Independent loads before the m-chain. Wide loads so the LSU queue is not filled with LD.E splits.

slices.name: Load stalls in GEMM
slices.floorLabel: hidden if S · B / L covers the load
slices.why: SMs wait on HBM between tiles. Only spend a method here if ncu shows DRAM full and SMs idle. Occupancy from the occupancy API, not from dividing totals.
slices.methodNote: num_stages=3 is in v9 (not GPU-checked). Full double-buffer + WGMMA/TMA only if proven. Check LD.E is not splitting 32 B into 2 × 16 B.

slices.name: Tile tail
slices.why: 18–64 tiles for 132 SMs. Not a hardware floor — idle SMs. Split-K reduction then needs a crossover: cluster DSMEM vs global atomics vs a second kernel.
slices.methodNote: Skinny BLOCK_M 16/32 (M05) + adaptive Split-K up to 8× (M01). Persistent kernel (M08) only after those land. Pick the reduction by the split dimension, not by habit.

slices.name: Dispatch + launches
slices.why: Five separate launches + host dispatch. The harness already graphs the timed region.
slices.methodNote: Replay the fixed sequence. Collapse the m-dispatch branch. Whole-layer graph is future work on decode_layer.

slices.name: Router 2nd pass
slices.why: x is read a second time. Three ops (2 mm + add) instead of one fused kernel.
slices.methodNote: One router kernel: read x once, both matmuls + add in-kernel, write once.

slices.name: Write drain
slices.why: After the last store, HBM still drains. Playbook: 4 SMs × 32 B/cycle × 1.96 GHz ≈ 251 GB/s → 1 MB takes ≈ 4.2 µs. A short store burst behind compute is almost free. Partial 32 B stores waste 30–63% write bandwidth.
slices.methodNote: Measure the drain in nsys before writing a store-path kernel. Do not treat playbook µs as this board's capture.

attn.name: attention_decode
attn.solving: One new token. Query is 1 row. The KV cache is the whole history.
attn.notSolving: Attention math (q·Kᵀ, softmax, p·V). That slice is ~15%.

trips.label: KV read · page table then payload — kernel time ≈ trips × latency, not bytes
after: math on the page already in flight

slices.name: KV stream
slices.why: Whole KV cache re-read per token. Goal is fewer round trips, not a smaller softmax.
slices.methodNote: Flash-Decoding: partition L across blocks. FP8 KV only after the same precision gate as bf16 step 3. Paged layout so appends do not break the next read.

slices.name: Attn math
slices.why: Do not tune the attention math while the KV stream dominates.
slices.methodNote: Stop on this slice until ncu shows compute bound.

slices.name: Merge partials
slices.why: Serial reduction waits on the slowest Split-KV block. Three cross-CTA options: cluster DSMEM, global atomics, second kernel. Switch at the batch/L crossover, not by habit.
slices.methodNote: Two-stage merge with log-sum-exp rescale. Pick the reduction path from the crossover plot once L and batch are known.

moe.name: moe_w4a16
moe.solving: Top-k experts. W4 weights, A16 activations.
moe.notSolving: A second full BF16 copy of the weights in HBM.

trips.label: Dequant as its own pass is an extra HBM round trip
after: unpack W4 in registers on the GEMM load

slices.name: Load + dequant
slices.why: Separate dequant = the biggest tensor pays the toll twice.
slices.methodNote: Unpack inside the GEMM load. Load top-k experts only.

slices.name: Gather
slices.why: Physical permute before the GEMM is an extra trip.
slices.methodNote: GEMM reads tokens through an index array.

slices.name: Grouped GEMM
slices.why: Ragged expert sizes underfill SMs — same disease as the bf16 tile tail.
slices.methodNote: Skinny tiles for small groups, Split-K for large. Occupancy API per group.

declayer.name: decode_layer
declayer.solving: One full decode layer. One token wide. ~8 small kernels in series.
declayer.notSolving: A single fat GEMM. The seams cost more than several of the kernels.

trips.label: Each kernel launch is a host/device trip. Count gaps, not just kernel bodies.

slices.name: Kernel gaps
slices.why: Time owned by no kernel. Kill gaps before polishing blocks.
slices.methodNote: Whole-layer CUDA Graph. Fuse RMSNorm + residual into neighbouring epilogues.

slices.name: Attention block
slices.methodNote: Apply attention_decode fixes inside the block after the graph lands.

prelayer.name: prefill_layer
prelayer.solving: Whole prompt at once. Large m. Tensor Cores can actually be busy.
prelayer.notSolving: The decode playbook (Split-K by default, gap hunting).

trips.label: Large m amortizes launches. Count HBM on the L×L scores and the KV write.

slices.name: Prefill attention
slices.floorLabel: Tensor Core peak · unknown until ncu
slices.why: The healthy problem. If ncu TFLOPS ≈ peak, this design has little left on math. If L×L spills, that is still a copy gap.
slices.methodNote: Keep scores in SRAM with online softmax. Classic GEMM tuning (M07) — not Split-K.

slices.name: KV cache write
slices.why: Written once here, re-read every decode token forever.
slices.methodNote: Write paged and contiguous per head at prefill time.
